about_the_game:
"Postcards are great, but I... I wanted to see the real things with my own two eyes."

- Story -

Experience the story of Kaelyn Kirena, who more than anything has always dreamed of traveling the world with her best friends at her side.
Unfortunately, fate hasn't been kind to Kay, and she was stricken partially blind by a strange, and debilitating illness.
Day after day, her eyesight continues to worsen -- to the point where she's beginning to lose hope that she'll ever get to see the wonderous landmarks of the world, as they are shown in the many postcards that she's collected since she was a child.

That was, until one day...

One day, her friends decide to take a chance.

They all gather up what money and resources they could for the sole mission of using it all to help their dear friend fulfill their lifelong wish -- to see the world, and all of the magnificent sights that it provides.

This grand journey across this wonderful planet of ours is set to begin.

The question is: will you be joining these friends on their big adventure?

It's time to go out and see the world!

- Features -

  • Travel the world with a colorful cast of characters, each with their own unique personalities and motivations!

  • Immerse yourself in an array of fully original backdrops that help breathe life into the many different locations the group will visit on their journey!

  • A diverse music score inspired by the real-world locations that change depending on the group's current destination!

  • Animated sprites with eye-catching character designs!

  •  While you're out exploring the world, uncover the strange family mystery that surrounds Kay and discover just what makes this small, but powerful girl so special.

  • Pick your traveling companion and grow your relationship with your chosen friend as your travels take you further. Will your relationship evolve into something more than just being childhood friends?

  • Over 20+ hours of content, with each traveling companion having their own deviations and endings to explore!

Thank you for checking out our game!
